A generous max_image_size accommodates a small data-URI image without warnings

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>Image: <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"></p>", new ConversionOptions { ExtractImages = true, MaxImageSize = 10485760 });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
